latestVersion.changelog:
Initial release of irisgo-humanizer

- Launches the "humanizer" skill for editing text to remove common AI writing patterns.
- Implements 24 detection and rewriting rules based on Wikipedia's "Signs of AI writing."
- Focuses on making AI-generated text sound natural and more human, including injecting personality and varied tone.
- Supports tools for reading, writing, editing, grepping, and globbing files.
- Provides detailed guidelines on avoiding AI-isms and adding authentic voice to writing.
